[type]
Parser

[grammar]
grammar star1;

top : ((A B) | (A C))* A EOF ;

A : 'a' ;
B : 'b' ;
C : 'c' ;

[start]
top

[input]
"""a"""
[output]
[output type=lexer-only-named-types]
[input name=B]
"""aba"""
[output name=B]
[output name=B type=lexer-only-named-types]
[input name=C]
"""aa"""
[output name=C]
[output name=C type=lexer-only-named-types]
